# Dibber

> Tickets as plain Markdown files in a git repository, for a person and their coding agent. One file per ticket, YAML frontmatter for its fields, the body for the work; closed tickets keep their file. A short spec, a JSON Schema, an optional CLI (`npx -y @immediately-run/dibber`) and agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, opencode and Antigravity.

## Set up

- [Install guide for coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/immediately-run/dibber/main/docs/install.md): set Dibber up in the current repository, step by step

## Reference

- [Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/immediately-run/dibber/main/SPEC.md): the format, rule by rule (R-DIB-n)
- [Ticket schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/immediately-run/dibber/main/ticket.schema.json): JSON Schema for a ticket's frontmatter
- [Config schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/immediately-run/dibber/main/config.schema.json): JSON Schema for `.dibber/config.json`
- [Checking tickets in CI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/immediately-run/dibber/main/docs/checking.md): `dibber check`, the GitHub Action and the pre-commit hook

## Optional

- [Website](https://immediately-run.github.io/dibber/): the same install steps, for people
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/immediately-run/dibber/main/README.md)
